radius_behaviour_how: Read ssot/PAGE_MAP.json, grouped aliases by object path, loaded each mapped SSOT object, and applied the current visual_abstract predicate to results.by_outcome.*.sensitivity.analyses. Proposed behaviour recognizes leave-one-out rows when id starts with 'leave-out', changed text starts with 'removing ' or contains ' by removing ', or the legacy row has a non-empty omitted field. still_excludes_null is read when boolean, otherwise derived from ci_low/ci_high under row.result or the row itself against outcome.null_value. Counted old/new emitted sentence strings. Denominators: 157 result outcomes on mapped objects, 149 mapped served pages with result outcomes, 163 total PAGE_MAP entries.

kinds.supporting_counts: 12 unique result-outcomes currently have sensitivity analyses; 39 sensitivity rows total; 34/39 rows are recognized as true leave-one-out after including legacy omitted rows; only tigecycline-ciai/cure_toc_me changes because its 8 sensitivity rows contain 3 true leave-one-out rows and no still_excludes_null booleans.

patch_old:
sens = res.get("sensitivity") or {}
    loo = ""
    rows = [a for a in (sens.get("analyses") or []) if isinstance(a, dict)]
    kept = [a for a in rows if a.get("still_excludes_null")]
    if rows:
        # A SENTENCE ABOUT A NUMBER MUST BE A FUNCTION OF THAT NUMBER.
        # The previous version appended "the estimate does not survive removal of the
        # largest trial" unconditionally, reading `kept` for the count and then ignoring it
        # for the claim. It printed "2 of 2 refits still exclude no difference; the estimate
        # does not survive removal of the largest trial" -- which is not merely contradictory,
        # it is false: if every refit excludes the null then the estimate DOES survive.
        # Measured before the fix: 6 of 12 emitted sentences were self-falsifying.
        _k = res.get("k") if res.get("k") is not None else len(res.get("per_trial") or [])
        _n, _tot = len(kept), len(rows)
        if _k == 2:
            # GENERALISED TO EVERY k=2 POOL, not special-cased to one topic. With two trials
            # a leave-one-out refit IS the other trial, so it cannot be robustness evidence
            # however the arithmetic comes out, and saying so is the honest reading.
            loo = ("Leave-one-out with two trials: each refit is simply the other trial, so "
                   "this is not robustness evidence. %d of %d single-trial refits exclude no "
                   "difference." % (_n, _tot))
        elif _n == _tot:
            loo = ("Leave-one-out: all %d refits still exclude no difference; the estimate "
                   "survives removal of any single trial." % _tot)
        elif _n == 0:
            loo = ("Leave-one-out: no refit excludes no difference; the estimate does not "
                   "survive removal of any single trial." % ())
        else:
            loo = ("Leave-one-out: %d of %d refits still exclude no difference; the estimate "
                   "does not survive removal of every single trial."
                   % (_n, _tot))
three_states: No sensitivity analyses: emit no leave-one-out sentence.
Sensitivity analyses exist but none are leave-one-out refits: emit no leave-one-out sentence from this visual-abstract slot.

Leave-one-out refits exist: summarize only those rows, deriving exclusion from explicit still_excludes_null or CI bounds against the outcome null; fail closed with a visible refusal if that derivation is impossible.
marker: Leave-one-out: 1 of 3 refits still exclude no difference
marker_absent_verified: Verified absent before writing this JSON with: $m = 'Leave-one-out: 1 of 3 refits still exclude no difference'; rg -F --no-messages -g '!out/cw/log*.txt' -- "$m" . ; exit code 1 and no matches. The out/cw/log*.txt exclusion avoids matching this investigation transcript, which had already logged earlier marker probes.
obvious_fix: One-line version: filter rows by id only, e.g. rows = [a for a in rows if str(a.get("id") or "").startswith("leave-out")].
obvious_fix_would_fire: Yes for Tigecycline: it selects 3/8 sensitivity rows on tigecycline-ciai/cure_toc_me. It is unsafe class-wide: only 1/13 PAGE_MAP page-outcomes with sensitivity rows has leave-out ids, while 12/13 use legacy non-empty omitted rows and would lose a valid leave-one-out sentence.
notes: gepotidacin is frozen and is not in the behaviour set. HFREF_NMA_AUTO_FULL_REVIEW.html is excluded and is not in PAGE_MAP for this count. ssot/build_tabbed.py is out of scope and was not edited.

item: COVID19_VACCINES_REVIEW.html labels a non-systematic per-vaccine snapshot as 'Review question (PICO)'
radius_file: 4/620 files under ssot, for ssot/projectors2.py as derived by Gate 7 with --files ssot/projectors2.py
radius_file_source: Command run: python gates/gate7_blast_radius.py --files ssot/projectors2.py. Gate 7 finding quoted: "ssot/projectors2.py is built through by 4 topics (outside the build closure, names 4 topic id(s)). This change touches it and no acknowledgement was recorded. Verifying it on one object is a claim about 1/4." Gate kinds quoted: 85 one-off module naming specific topics; 38 shared non-module file; 26 module outside the build closure; 3 CLASS-WIDE module (in the build closure); 468 topic-owned file (radius 1); 1 files in this change under ssot. Gate also notes the widest class-wide build roots separately: paper_projector.py(155), build_tabbed.py(155), build_app_v2.py(155).
radius_behaviour: 1/163 PAGE_MAP entries would change under the safe conditional; 1/155 SSOT topic objects matches the explicit non-systematic-review/snapshot predicate.
radius_behaviour_how: Loaded all ssot/<topic>/<topic>.json topic objects and PAGE_MAP entries. Matched only objects whose question/introduction explicitly says 'not a systematic review', 'per-vaccine snapshot', or 'does not combine vaccines'. Exactly covid19-vaccines matched: 1/155 topic objects and 1/163 PAGE_MAP entries. Separately, the unsafe literal replacement surface was measured with rg and is 432/1947 recursive *_REVIEW.html files, not the proposed safe behaviour set.
three_states: Explicit scope snapshot or non-systematic evidence object: label 'Review question / evidence scope'.
Unclassifiable or missing question: refuse or emit a neutral 'Question / scope not classified' state rather than forcing either PICO or scope.
marker_absent_verified: Verified absent before writing this JSON with: $m = 'Review question / evidence scope'; rg -F --no-messages -g '!out/cw/log*.txt' -- "$m" . ; exit code 1 and no matches. The out/cw/log*.txt exclusion avoids matching this investigation transcript, which had already logged earlier marker probes.
obvious_fix: One-line version from the escalation: replace every ("Review question (PICO)", p(canon["question"])) with ("Review question / scope", p(canon["question"])).
obvious_fix_would_fire: Yes, and too broadly. The exact planted command rg -l "Review question \\(PICO\\)" -g "*_REVIEW.html" . --no-messages | Measure-Object returned 432 hits. A recursive classifier found 432/1947 *_REVIEW.html files would be touched: 429 live pages, 3 retired tombstones, 0 redirect stubs. It would intersect 28/29 out/must_not_break pages: AGYW_HIV_PREP_REVIEW.html, ALIROCUMAB_LIPID_AUTO_FULL_REVIEW.html, APIXABAN_VTE_PROPHYLAXIS_REVIEW.html, APIXABAN_VTE_TREATMENT_REVIEW.html, ARNI_HF_REVIEW.html, AZILSARTAN_CLD_VS_OLM_HCTZ_REVIEW.html, AZILSARTAN_HTN_AUTO_FULL_REVIEW.html, BEMPEDOIC_ACID_REVIEW.html, BOCOCIZUMAB_LIPID_AUTO_FULL_REVIEW.html, BOCOCIZUMAB_LIPID_REVIEW.html, CAB_PREP_HIV_REVIEW.html, CANGRELOR_PCI_REVIEW.html, CEFTAROLINE_AUTO_FULL_REVIEW.html, EMPAGLIFLOZIN_HF_AUTO_FULL_REVIEW.html, FINERENONE_CV_REVIEW.html, ICOSAPENT_LIPID_AUTO_FULL_REVIEW.html, INCLISIRAN_LIPID_KIDNEY_AUTO_FULL_REVIEW.html, INCRETIN_HFpEF_REVIEW.html, IV_IRON_HF_REVIEW.html, LEFAMULIN_CABP_AUTO_FULL_REVIEW.html, NIRSEVIMAB_INFANT_RSV_REVIEW.html, ROSUVASTATIN_AUTO_FULL_REVIEW.html, ROTAVIRUS_VACCINE_AFRICA_REVIEW.html, ROTAVIRUS_VACCINE_AUTO_FULL_REVIEW.html, SGLT2_HF_REVIEW.html, SGLT2_MACE_CVOT_REVIEW.html, SOTAGLIFLOZIN_HF_REVIEW.html, TIGECYCLINE_CIAI_SSOT.html.
